The current page number.

parameters.help_en: The name of the alert contact

Mail: email.

DingWebHook: DingTalk chatbot

Mail：邮件。

parameters.name: chanel_type

报警类型的值。

parameters.name: chanel_value

DingWebHook.description_en: The webhook URL of the DingTalk chatbot

ChannelsState.description_en:
The status of the alert channel.

<props="china">Text messages, phone numbers, and email addresses must be activated before they can be used. When you add or modify an alert channel, the status is PENDING if the channel is not activated, and OK if the channel is activated.</props>

<props="intl">Email addresses must be activated before they can be used. When you add or modify an alert channel, the status is PENDING if the channel is not activated, and OK if the channel is activated.</props>

<props="partner">Email addresses must be activated before they can be used. When you add or modify an alert channel, the status is PENDING if the channel is not activated, and OK if the channel is activated.</props>
ChannelsState.description_zh:
报警通道的状态。

<props="china">因为短信、电话号码和Email需要激活以后才能使用，所以当添加或修改报警通道时，如果处于未激活状态，则为PENDING；如果处于激活状态，则为OK。</props>

<props="intl">因为Email需要激活以后才能使用，所以当添加或修改报警通道时，如果处于未激活状态，则为PENDING；如果处于激活状态，则为OK。</props>

<props="partner">因为Email需要激活以后才能使用，所以当添加或修改报警通道时，如果处于未激活状态，则为PENDING；如果处于激活状态，则为OK。</props>

AliIM.description_en:
The status of the TradeManager name is normal.

Currently, only the value OK is supported. OK indicates that the TradeManager name is normal, the corresponding alert channel is normal, and alerts can be sent.

This parameter is applicable only to the China site
AliIM.description_zh:
旺旺名称的状态正常。

目前取值只支持：OK。OK表示旺旺名状态正常，对应的报警通道正常，可正常报警。

该参数仅适用于中国站

DingWebHook.description_en:
The status of the DingTalk chatbot is normal.

Currently, only the value OK is supported. OK indicates that the DingTalk chatbot is normal, the corresponding alert channel is normal, and alerts can be sent
DingWebHook.description_zh:
钉钉机器人的状态正常。

目前取值只支持：OK。OK表示钉钉机器人状态正常，对应的报警通道正常，可正常报警

Mail.description_en:
The status of the email address. Valid values:
PENDING: The alert channel is not activated. Activate it before use.
OK: The alert channel is normal and alerts can be sent
Mail.description_zh:
Email的状态。取值：
PENDING：对应报警通道未激活，激活后才能使用。
OK：对应报警通道正常，可正常报警

SMS.description_en:
The status of text messages. Valid values:
PENDING: The alert channel is not activated. Activate it before use.
OK: The alert channel is normal and alerts can be sent.

This parameter is applicable only to the China site
SMS.description_zh:
短信的状态。取值：
PENDING：对应报警通道未激活，激活后才能使用。
OK：对应报警通道正常，可正常报警。

该参数仅适用于中国站
